program: American Express Table for Two by Platinum

eligibility_source.program_rule: Public holidays and the eve of each public holiday

clauses.title: Eligibility
clauses.summary: The program covers Basic and Supplementary members of the Singapore-issued Platinum Card. This document scope does not determine whether a particular person or card qualifies.

clauses.title: Benefit cycle
clauses.summary: One complimentary dining offer is made available every two months, up to six times in 2026. An unused offer does not carry into a later cycle.

clauses.title: Shared Card Account
clauses.summary: Basic and Supplementary members can see the offer, but it is usable once per Card Account in each redemption cycle.

clauses.title: Guests and additional diners
clauses.summary: The offer is for two people and at least one diner must be an eligible Card Member. Additional diners must be declared in the booking portal, remain subject to merchant availability, and incur additional cost paid with the eligible card. The program terms do not state how children are counted.

clauses.title: Solo dining and takeaway
clauses.summary: A solo diner still receives food intended for two, and offer food is dine-in only rather than available for takeaway.

clauses.title: Booking and confirmation
clauses.summary: A valid booking must be made through the Experiences App. Capacity is first-come, first-served; confirmation requires a successful merchant-site reservation and merchant SMS. American Express does not guarantee a booking or availability.

clauses.title: Menus and additional costs
clauses.summary: Displayed menu prices cover additional diners beyond the standard two and extra costs must be paid with the eligible card. If the cycle voucher was already redeemed, the document says the diner may instead pay the merchant directly using the eligible card and choose the curated or regular menu. Actual dishes must be checked in the current menu.

clauses.title: Merchant changes and blackout dates
clauses.summary: Participating merchants can change by cycle without notice, merchant blackout dates may apply, and the document lists public holidays and their eves as program-wide blackout dates.

clauses.title: Cancellation and no-show policies
clauses.summary: Each merchant sets its own cancellation policy. Card Members must review it before booking, and American Express says it is not liable for fees caused by a policy violation. The program document does not provide a venue-specific fee or deadline.

clauses.title: Combining the offer
clauses.summary: The offer cannot be exchanged for cash or in-kind and cannot be combined with other offers, promotions, privileges, or discounts unless stated otherwise.

documents.title: Table for Two - Platinum Edition Terms and Conditions

clauses.title: Voucher issue dates and cycles
clauses.summary: The Experiences App provides one voucher for each two-month cycle beginning 1 January, March, May, July, September, and November. Each voucher must be used within its own cycle.

clauses.title: Why a date is unavailable
clauses.summary: A date can be unavailable because all seats were booked or because the restaurant has not opened reservations for that date. The FAQ recommends trying another restaurant or checking again later; this is not a current seat claim.

clauses.title: Guest selector and even-numbered capacity
clauses.summary: If a party-size option is missing, the remaining capacity may be too small. The FAQ says slots are released in even numbers, while odd-sized bookings can leave an odd number of seats. Try another time or date for a larger party.

clauses.title: OTP attempts and locked access
clauses.summary: OTP attempts proceed by SMS, then WhatsApp, then automated voice call, with two minutes between attempts. If access remains blocked, the FAQ directs users to DiningCity support or the number on the back of the Card. Never send credentials or an OTP to this bot.

clauses.title: Reservation confirmation
clauses.summary: DiningCity sends an SMS with the confirmation and reservation code after a completed booking. The link in that message manages the reservation; missing messages should be raised with DiningCity support.

clauses.title: Voucher already marked used
clauses.summary: A voucher marked used may have been redeemed by another Basic or Supplementary member on the shared Card Account. The FAQ suggests reinstalling and signing in again, then calling the number on the back of the Card if the issue continues. An unused voucher can be reinstated after verification.

clauses.title: MYCA authentication
clauses.summary: The FAQ says all users, including existing app users, must complete MYCA authentication again. Do not send credentials to this bot.

clauses.title: Biometric login after 90 days
clauses.summary: After 90 days, the app requires MYCA credentials again before biometric login can continue. Do not send credentials to this bot.
